title: Design System: Phoenix United FC - The Route Room

display.purpose: Compressed only for the hero, route reveal, belief peak, and closing statement.

body.purpose: Programme explanation, wayfinding, and form guidance.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.purpose: A single authored route and tunnel-image reveal.

components.name: Primary Evaluation Button
components.description: The gold action that opens the working qualification form.

components.name: Route Stop
components.description: A connected city, club, and pathway function on the Dubai to Europe route.

narrative.overview: A football club tunnel becomes an international departures board. One gold line begins in Dubai and connects the player to Manchester, the Algarve, and a serious next decision.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, useful wayfinding instead of empty cards
Distinct cinematic, editorial, ledger, and application chapters
Gold reserved for active routes, decisions, and primary actions

rules.name: The Route Rule
rules.body: Gold connects places, decisions, or actions and is never scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Variable Voice Rule
rules.body: Font width changes establish hierarchy instead of making every line uniformly huge.

dos: Start the story in Dubai and show Manchester and Algarve in sequence.
Preserve the pitch, the ball, faces, and real football context.
Compose mobile as identity, promise, human image, primary action, then route.
donts: Do not use broad empty cream slabs or generic comparison tables.
Do not build the page from equal cards.
Do not use the same compressed headline treatment in every section.
Do not use gold for ordinary labels, links, or rules.
Do not use transformed identity assets or invented outcomes.
